entries.cause: Revert of PR 1068 for issue 1014 removes the authored 1880 shortfallPrestige and submarineThreat blocks so the TRADE_SHORTFALL prestige loss goes and the shortfall pressure draw returns; every checkpoint returns to its exact 2dec5121 hash
entries.migrationAssessment: No save state shape changes and the removed blocks were optional; saves taken on dev between PR 1068 and this revert replay with the pre 1068 outcome
